purpose: Preserve reproducibility of the comparable-fragment figures published in docs/design/spec-agreement-proposal.md Rev 1 §0.3 and §0.4 M-2.

gate_ref.approximation: classifyContractFragment approximated as 'at least one clause present'. Generous, so every measured figure is an UPPER BOUND on comparability.

row_counting_rule: EC-4: a row is comparable only when every clause citing it lives in a comparable contract. Rows are matched to clauses by the leading [cid] of the clause :source field; only rows dispositioned Encoded in the run inventory are counted.
